app.title: ReStructura
panel.title: Pin
panel.label: Label
status.ready: Scroll to zoom · drag to pan · click a pin to open it · Ctrl+A / C / X / V / Delete work on pins · F1 opens Help
status.clicked: Clicked at x {x} px, y {y} px
toolbar.addPinActive: Click the plan to place the pin…
panel.deleteConfirm: Delete this pin? This cannot be undone.
status.saved: Pin #{id} saved at x {x} px, y {y} px
status.noTauri: Not running inside the desktop app, so the database is unavailable
panel.labelPlaceholder: What is here? e.g. Cold water riser
panel.notesPlaceholder: Material, size, distances from reference points, anything you would want to know before drilling…
chooser.title: Projects
chooser.intro: One project per home. Everything a project needs lives in one folder, so it can be exported as a single file and opened on another computer.
chooser.deleteConfirm: Delete the project “{name}”? Its folder is moved to the system trash, so it can be recovered from there.
start.title: This project has no plan yet
start.intro: A project holds one or more floors: a storey, a mezzanine, a basement. Add the first one:
start.importHint: PNG or JPEG. A scan, a photo of the drawing, or an export from your architect.
start.draw: Draw the plan in the editor
start.drawHint: Start from an empty sheet and draw walls, doors and windows to scale.
legend.title: Legend
legend.hint: Click a category to show or hide its pins
meas.title: Measurements
meas.refPlaceholder: e.g. left jamb of the kitchen door
meas.invalid: Not a length. Use for example 112, 112 cm or 1.12 m
meas.hint: Measured to the centre of the item. Type the length in any unit: 112, 112 cm, 1.12 m, 44 in.
photos.title: Photos
photos.captionPlaceholder: Caption: what does this photo show?
photos.removeConfirm: Remove this photo from the pin? It can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
history.caption: edit caption
status.editPosition: Click the plan where the pin should go. Each click moves it. Press Done or Esc when finished
panel.deleteManyConfirm: Delete {n} pins? This can be undone with Ctrl+Z.
shortcuts.hint: Ctrl+A select all · Ctrl+C/X/V copy, cut, paste · Delete · Ctrl+Z undo
room.title: Room label
room.name: Name
room.deleteConfirm: Delete the label “{name}”? Pins tagged with it become untagged.
room.placing: Click where the room label should go · Esc cancels
room.moving: Click where the label should go · Done or Esc when finished
scale.tooltip: Distances on the plan are approximate: they depend on how accurately the plan was drawn, scanned and calibrated. Measurements you type on a pin are unaffected.
scale.pick: Click the two ends of something you have measured, one wall is enough · Hold Shift to keep the line horizontal or vertical · Esc cancels
scale.pick2: Now click the other end · Hold Shift to keep the line horizontal or vertical · Esc cancels
scale.prompt: How long is that in reality?
scale.promptHint: Type the measured length, e.g. 420, 420 cm or 4.2 m. This is an approximation: plan, scan and clicks all carry small errors.
scale.done: Calibrated: 1 px = {cm} cm · distances are approximate
scale.tooShort: Those two points are too close together. Pick a longer distance for a better result
measure.pick: Click the first point · Esc cancels
measure.pick2: Click the second point · Hold Shift to keep the line horizontal or vertical · Esc cancels
measure.needCalibration: Calibrate the plan first to measure real distances
measure.hintSelect: Click a measurement to select it, then press Delete to remove it
measure.constrain: Hold Shift to keep the line horizontal or vertical
search.title: Search
settings.title: Settings
settings.appHint: How you like to work. Kept on this computer, so a project you send to someone else arrives with their preferences, not yours.
settings.projectHint: Travels with the project when you export it.
settings.unitsHint: Display only. Lengths are always stored in centimetres, so a project opens correctly whichever system you use. You can type any unit at any time: 112, 1.12 m, 44 in, 3' 8".
report.title: Print report
report.printHint: Your browser's print dialog opens next. Choose “Save as PDF” as the destination.
report.uncalibrated: Not calibrated, so distances on this plan are not to scale
report.approx: Distances derived from the plan are approximate. Measurements listed against a pin were taken by hand.
export.title: Export
export.zipHint: Everything: plans, photos and data. Opens on another computer.
report.blocked: Could not open the print view. The report was saved instead: {path}
editor.hintWall: Click to start a wall · Clicks join existing corners and walls · Hold Ctrl for no snapping · Esc switches to Select
editor.hintChain: Click the next corner, or type a length and press Enter · Click the same point again or press Enter to stop · Backspace takes back the last wall
editor.hintSelect: Click a wall, door or window to select it · Shift-click adds more · Click a selected door or window again to slide it along its wall · Click a round handle to move a corner · Delete removes
editor.hintMove: Click where the corner should go · Walls joined there follow · Esc cancels
editor.needScale: Walls are drawn to scale, so this plan needs calibrating first: click the two ends of a wall you have measured
editor.tooShort: That would make a wall with no length
mode.label: Mode
mode.documentTip: Pins, photos, room names and measurements
mode.drawTip: Plan editor: walls, doors and windows
editor.unitTip: A plain number is read in this unit. Other units work too: 350, 3.5 m, 11' 6"
editor.fromTip: Distance from the nearer corner of the wall to the edge of the opening
editor.flipSideTip: Open towards the other side of the wall (F)
editor.flipHingeTip: Hinge, or pocket, at the other end (H)
editor.hintDoor: Click on a wall where the door starts, on the hinge side · Ctrl: no snapping · Esc switches to Select
editor.hintWindow: Click on a wall where the window starts · Ctrl: no snapping · Esc switches to Select
editor.hintPlace2: Click where it ends, or type a width and press Enter · Move the mouse to the side of the wall it should open towards · Esc cancels
editor.hintMoveOpening: Click where it should go along the wall · Esc cancels
editor.notOnWall: Doors and windows go in a wall: click on one
editor.overlap: That would overlap another door or window in this wall
editor.tooNarrow: Too narrow: an opening needs at least 20 cm
opening.info: {kind}: {w} wide, {d} from the corner · F flips the side, H the hinge
help.title: Help
help.search: Search help: pin, photo, wall, door, shortcut…
help.noResults: Nothing found for “{q}”. Try a shorter or different word.
